results.title: Ace Attorney - Wikipedia
results.content:
With storytelling fashioned after legal dramas, the first entry in the series, Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney, was released in 2001; since then, five further main series games as well as various spin-offs, prequels, and high-definition remasters for newer game consoles have been released.
The Great Ace Attorney Chronicles contains both games in The Great Ace Attorney series: Adventures and 2: Resolve.

results.title: Ace Attorney (series) | Capcom Database | Fandom
results.content:
As of September 30, 2022, the game series has sold 9.6 million units worldwide.
A stage play based on the series, titled Gyakuten no Spotlight, ran in 2013, and was written by Eisaku Saito.
A 2012 live-action film adaptation of the first game, titled Ace Attorney, was produced at the film studio Toei and directed by Takashi Miike.
A 2016 TV anime adaptation of the series, Ace Attorney, was produced at A-1 Pictures and directed by Ayumu Watanabe.

results.title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy - Wikipedia
results.content:
It consists of the first three installments in the Ace Attorney series of visual novel adventure games: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney (2001), Justice for All (2002), and Trials and Tribulations (2004).
Several other compilations have followed, including Apollo Justice: Ace Attorney Trilogy (2024) with the series' next three mainline installments.
